title: Remember Freedom
author: Mitra Samal
text:
If you remember freedom
There will always be a way
to break the walls between us
You will have invisible wings
to cross the borders that divide us
You will feel the whipping winds
that do not decide where
to strike and at whom
The fire in your heart will ignite
minds that will be unbiased

If you remember freedom
You know what it is to smile
A smile that accentuates the eyes
and precedes a carefree laughter
You know the song of a free land
that escapes beyond the sky

To be free is to speak without fear
To live without disguise
To be able to love and be loved
without being questioned or judged

To remember freedom is to
reminisce spring in winter
To wait for the sun in darkness
If you remember freedom
you will always be free

They may enslave your body but
the mind can never be held captive
It will break free from all the hurdles
that are thrust upon it
You just need to remember freedom
and speak what it is to be free
